xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order u/s. 73 of CGST/MGST Act read with Sec 20 of IGST Act Name of Entity: G.S.Pharmaceutical Distributors Private Limited Imposed Penalty: Rs. 8,10,172
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Penalty is levied under section 73 of the GST Act for excess claim of ITC claimed on account of non-reconciliation. Contravention of the provisions of 16, 42, 50, 73, 74 and 75 of GST Act,2017
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The amount demanded along-with the interest and penalty neither have any material impact on the financials of the G.S.
